def transform(grid):
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [row + clockwise[i] for i, row in enumerate(grid)] + [counterclockwise[i] + half_turn[i] for i in range(len(grid))]
